title: Do doublets favor positions within sentences?
question: Do the 86 LP2 doublets cluster by sentence-relative rune position modulo two through eight?
reader_question: Are repeated runes placed at particular points in sentences?
summary: All seven public sentence-relative residue counts reproduce from pinned punctuation boundaries, but 2,068 of 5,000 section-preserving controls show a best pattern at least as strong.
finding: The strongest tested grouping is modulo three (26, 23, 37 events); its selected score is matched or exceeded in 2,068 of 5,000 controls. A concentrated planted pattern is detected.
limitations: Only position residues modulo 2â€“8 under the pinned relikd punctuation rule and uniform within-section event-placement control were tested. Other punctuation rules, event clustering and cipher-specific position laws are not covered.
next_steps: Any proposed sentence-based cipher should declare its punctuation and reset rule, predict specific doublet positions or decoded text, and compare with a matching control rather than selecting a residue after inspection.

scope.representation: All 12,956 runes of the nine LP2 unsolved sections, with source-derived sentence reset rune ordinals from the pinned relikd text. A doublet event is placed at its second rune.
scope.procedure: Recount all 86 doublets; measure sentence-relative positions modulo 2â€“8; compare the largest chi-square/df score with the same seven-way maximum in 5,000 placements retaining each section's number of events and the punctuation boundaries. Verify a concentrated planted modulo-seven pattern.
scope.parameters: Nine fixed sections, 86 events, seven moduli, random.Random(3301), 5,000 controls; ties counted in the upper tail.
scope.exclusions: Different punctuation or source text, word-relative and section-relative coordinates, moduli outside 2â€“8, event identities, cipher-specific nulls and plaintext recovery.

reproduction.environment: Python 3 standard library. Optional upstream-byte verification uses check.py --source-pages with the pinned relikd checkout.
